notes: Merged 2026-11-09 on upstream-sync/v3.0.0-beta.3.alpha.4. The language files are a real 3-way merge (upstream's strings plus the fork's keys; the three keys upstream deleted are gone), and the ts-rs bindings are regenerated. The UI is upstream's alpha.4 layout with the fork's mounts: SpatialStage in the Codecs device card, DeviceEffects on Home and the flyout, the engine tag on Home, Connect only (no Disconnect). The spatial engine runs through upstream's alpha.4 encode loop and voice link. Upstream's new alpha.3/alpha.4 work is in: DPAPI-encrypted pairing keys, the LE Audio switch, the microphone changes and the AVRCP PASS_THROUGH fix, which btstack-sys/build.rs patches at build time; the btstack submodule carries no local patch (5bc5cbd, clean). Known red, proven at the tag in a detached worktree at v3.0.0-beta.3.alpha.4: ReceiverTest 'finds the receiver, measures and compares' and 'disconnects, searches and connects to a receiver found', and leAudio 'lists a dual-mode device twice with LE Audio on, with its tags' time out at 5000 ms under the full suite; each passes alone.
